title: HDX entry (draft 0.3.0)
description: One experimental context and method. Adds a structured peptide workflow with explicit reporting status for identification, envelope evaluation, controls, calibration, reproducibility, validity, differential interpretation and mapping. Missing numeric observations are null; observed zero is valid. This draft is not yet emitted by the pipeline.

selector.description: Extension: the fields and rows of a shared multi-row file that a link refers to.

artifact_ref.description: Exact artifact and optional field/row selector. IDs resolve within the owning entry. A reference does not establish accessibility or byte integrity.

software.description: One actual tool and its role. Version may be null when not recorded. A repository commit must not be assigned to other tools in the same workflow.

criterion.description: Declared acceptance or statistical rule, not a schema-selected scientific threshold. Null means the threshold was not recorded.

manual_review.description: Curation or envelope review history. A CLEANED filename alone does not establish the reviewer, criteria or individual decisions.

peptide_row.description: L1a map row in one-based inclusive construct numbering. Preserve excluded candidates. Evidence can select MS/MS scans, scores and source identification rows.

envelope_row.description: L1b per-charge envelope evidence. Null time with explicit control_type replaces infinite time. Preserve rejected envelopes and their evidence.

uptake_row.description: L1b charges-merged observation. State, actual time, replicate and peptide remain explicit. Null uptake is missing, never replaced by zero.

calibrated_row.description: A separate L1d observation with explicit L1b parent. Unit and calibration scale must be stated.

reproducibility_row.description: L1 technical reproducibility cell. Replicate counts must describe independent experimental units, not charge states.

validity_row.description: L2 validity decision about an L1 observation. An accepted observation may still have no significant differential result.

projection_row.description: L2 projection from overlapping peptides. A numeric summary need not represent a single time or individual-amide measurement.

mapping_row.description: L3 mapping to a structural model. Mapping establishes neither identity of experimental conditions nor structural validation.

peptide_table.description: Inline records or an exact external table and a mapping of every canonical column to its source field. External bytes require separate validation against the row definition.

identification_stage.description: L1a identification of peptides before deuterated uptake analysis. Recorded means some evidence is available, not that all metadata are known. Search settings are distinct from acceptance thresholds.

envelope_processing_stage.description: L1b upstream extraction and evaluation of deuterated envelopes, before charge merging. Record software for each actual role and decisions for rejected envelopes.

uptake_stage.description: L1b uptake by state, time, replicate and peptide after charge merging; retain per-charge evidence upstream.

controls_stage.description: L1c optional maximally labeled controls, alternative maximum-uptake estimates or internal reporter metadata. If absent, explicitly report not performed or not recorded.

correction.description: L1d separate correction execution. Distinct input/output selectors are required even within one file. Original uncorrected measurements remain addressable. Reanalysis uses retained inputs; an algebraic inverse is not promised.

calibration_stage.description: L1d calibration branches. Each correction has a separate run and parameters. Corrections never overwrite inputs.

reproducibility_stage.description: L1 technical reproducibility of measurements, separate from L2 validity and differential inference.

validity_stage.description: L2 valid/excluded/not-tested decisions about L1 measurements. Significance is not a validity filter.

differential_stage.description: L2 differential testing and peptide classification from stated input validity decisions and uptake version. Does not claim mechanical rigidity or validated error control.

projection_stage.description: L2 residue projection from overlapping peptides in construct coordinates, independent of any structure. Resolution remains limited by peptides and the projection model.

structural_mapping_stage.description: L3 mapping to structural models, not agreement or validation. Residue projection is L2 and does not require a coordinate model.

peptide_workflow.description: Peptide HDX workflow. Every stage has an explicit reporting/performance status, including absent controls or analyses. Raw instrument files remain entry artifacts at L0. Not recorded does not mean not performed.

hdx.description: Extension: HDX experimental block, one record per sample (construct, replicate, labeling conditions), modeled on crystallography.crystals[].

measurement.description: index of the measurement within its construct, or 'mean'

mean_of_rows.description: source rows a mean averages, identified by recomputation

conditions_differ.description: the averaged measurements differ in pH, temperature or buffer

peptide_map.description: Extension: peptide count and coverage, with the identification run (L1a).

processing_roles.description: Optional roles for multi-level files; broad artifact.level remains L0-L3. Selectors separate the content used by runs.

parameters.description: Generic legacy parameters. Structured peptide workflow details additionally document method-specific metadata and missing information.

undeclared_inputs.description: Extension: sources a model depends on that cannot be registered as artifacts because no URI is known.

model_type.description: 'HDX ΔG set' and 'HDX differential set' are extensions: L2 interpretations without coordinates.

residue_frame.description: Extension: the reference model whose label_* numbering the residue data use.

site_data.description: Extension: values for sites not assigned to residues.

extensions.description: Fields or values not defined in Dynamic PDB v0.2.0.

ligands.description: CCD identifiers in the sample or deposited model
